fdroid:com.github.vgaj.proxy.name: Proxy Exit
fdroid:com.github.vgaj.proxy.summary: Use your phone's mobile connection as a proxy for desktop browsers.
fdroid:com.github.vgaj.proxy.description:
Proxy Exit is NOT a way to set up a proxy on your phone. It is a part of a setup to route your desktop browser's internet traffic through your phone's mobile data connection.
Setup requires three components: a Proxy Server, this app, and a configured browser.
● Start the Proxy Server
Run the following Docker command on a machine accessible from the internet:
docker run -d -p 8888:8888 -p 9999:9999 -e AUTH_CODE=XXX registry.gitlab.com/viru7/proxy:latest
Port 8888 — browser HTTP proxy connections
Port 9999 — mobile app connections
XXX — your chosen password
If the server is running on a home machine, ensure port 9999 is forwarded to it.
● Configure the app
Enter the server's IP address, port (9999), and your password, then tap Start.
Keep the app running in the foreground while in use. If the connection to the server drops, the app will automatically retry every minute.
● Configure your browser
Set the browser's HTTP and HTTPS proxy to the server's IP address and port (8888).
How it works:
1. The app connects to the Proxy Server, making the phone available as a proxy exit node.
2. When the browser needs to make an HTTP request, it sends it to the Proxy Server.
3. The Proxy Server forwards the request to the phone over the established connection.
4. The phone fetches the content via mobile data and returns it through the server to the browser.
For more details see: https://gitlab.com/viru7/proxy

fdroid:com.podxboq.yahora.name: Yahora
fdroid:com.podxboq.yahora.summary: One tap records that something happened. There is nothing else to fill in
fdroid:com.podxboq.yahora.description:
Yahora is a minimalist event logger. You give a recurring event a name, and from
then on a single tap on its chip records the date and time it happened. No
intermediate screen, no confirmation dialog, no extra fields to fill in.
Most tracking apps grow into note-taking tools: nested categories, custom
fields, reminders, dashboards. Yahora deliberately does not. A tag has a name, a
favourite flag and, if you like, a colour; an entry has a timestamp. That is the
entire model, and the design goal follows from it — recording an event should
cost one tap and zero attention. That simplicity is the point, not a step on the
way to something bigger: nothing here is designed to keep you in the app or to
bring you back to it.
 What it does 
* Tag cloud — chips flow across the screen, each as wide as its name and all
 sharing one type size, sorted alphabetically. Favourites are marked with a
 star, which changes the emphasis but never the order.
* One-tap logging — a short tap records the current timestamp right away, with
 a haptic tick as confirmation, and offers to undo it from its own snackbar.
* Long press for everything else — rename a tag, mark it as a favourite, or
 browse its history. Actions that do not apply are hidden, not greyed out.
* Colour, if you want one — any colour you pick, as a tab behind the chip.
* History as a tree — months, then days, then the individual entries at
 HH:mm:ss. Each branch says how many children it holds.
* Statistics — how many times each tag was logged, by year and month. Pick
 tags to add them up together. Numbers you read at a glance, no charts.
* Backup — save the whole log to a file you choose, and restore it on this
 phone or a new one.
* Safe by construction — a tag that holds entries cannot be deleted, so a
 history is never lost by accident. Old entries go only in whole months,
 days or tags, after a confirmation that says how many.
 Privacy 
Yahora is fully offline. It declares no network permission, so it cannot reach
the internet even by accident: no accounts, no analytics, no advertising and no
third-party libraries beyond Android's own. Everything you log stays in the
app's private database on your device, unless you save a backup file yourself.
Yahora is free software under the GNU General Public License v3 or later.

fdroid:com.roundsalmon4.appverifier.name: AppVerifier BG
fdroid:com.roundsalmon4.appverifier.summary: Verify installed apps against shared signature hashes and databases.
fdroid:com.roundsalmon4.appverifier.description:
AppVerifier BG verifies that installed Android apps match their expected signing certificate fingerprints. Compare an app's signing hash against shared text, an internal database synced from Privacy Guides, or your own user database. Hashes are checked for valid SHA-256 format — when verification fails, they're labeled "Expected" vs "Found" so you can tell which is which. Apps signed with debug certificates are flagged as insecure. Split APK bundles (.apks, .apkm, .xapk) and ZIP files containing a base APK are also accepted.
 App List 
Every installed user app shows status icons for internal database matches, user database entries, clipboard verification, and shared text matches at a glance. Sort by name, database status, debug builds, clipboard verified, or shared text — pick whichever you need from the dropdown, and it only shows modes with matching data. A filter chip hides everything except mismatches. The default sort order can be set in settings. Search by name or package name. Long-press an app with a user database entry or clipboard checkmark to remove it individually.
 Internal Database 
Built-in database of verified app hashes synced from privacyguides/verified-apps, updated with each build. The database download is verified against GitHub attestations before every build.
 Combined Database Status 
See internal and user database results side by side on the app list and verification screen. A setting lets you choose between both, internal only, or user database only.
 User Database 
Save verification info for later. Add entries individually from the verification screen or bulk-add from shared text. Supports import and export in JSON, text, and YAML formats (auto-detected on import, choose on export). Import lets you combine with existing entries or replace them, and shows a summary of what changed. Entries can be removed individually by long-pressing the app in the list, or removed in batch from selection mode.
 Shared Text 
Share verification info for several apps at once. Multiple entries separated by blank lines are accepted on receive. Shared text with multiple entries filters the app list to show matching apps only, with icons indicating hash match status. Bulk-add all verified matches to your database from the filtered list. AppVerifier also handles ACTION_SEND and ACTION_VIEW intents so you can share text or APK files directly from other apps.
 Clipboard Verification 
Verify from clipboard with a single button on the startup screen. Successful clipboard verifications add a blue checkmark in the app list. The checkmark can be toggled on or off in settings and cleared separately. Individual checkmarks can be removed by long-pressing the app in the list.
 Hash-Only Verification 
Paste or share a SHA-256 hash on its own and AppVerifier BG will find every installed app signed with that certificate. Handy when someone shares just a hash without a package name. If multiple installed apps share the same signing key, a picker lets you choose the right one.
 Share All Apps 
Share every installed app's verification info as text from the settings screen.
 Theme Customization 
Follow system theme, or pick light or dark mode. An AMOLED black theme option replaces all surfaces with pure black for OLED screens. On Android 12+, dynamic color pulls from your wallpaper. Primary and secondary colors are customizable with 12 preset swatches each.
 Reproducible Builds 
Release builds use SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and deterministic R8 so the same tag always produces the same APK.
This is a fork of soupslurpr/AppVerifier with additional features.

fdroid:com.saad_khan_rind.atmosphere_eff.name: Atmo Engine
fdroid:com.saad_khan_rind.atmosphere_eff.summary: Live wallpapers with transitions, wake effects, a wallpaper clock and playlists.
fdroid:com.saad_khan_rind.atmosphere_eff.description:
Atmo Engine turns your images into customizable live wallpapers, with optional lock-screen-to-home-screen transitions.
Atmo Engine is an open-source wallpaper studio inspired by the Atmosphere effect in Nothing OS. Choose an image, preview and fine-tune the effect, then apply it through Android's live wallpaper screen.
EFFECTS (each with a reverse)
• Atmosphere, with optional reeded glass
• Glass
• Color Fill
• Canvas Sketch
• Simple Frosted
• Halftone Print
• VHS Tape
• Zoom In and Zoom Out
Previews use the same image, settings, and graphics API as the live wallpaper.
TRANSITIONS OR ALWAYS-APPLIED EFFECTS
Turn transitions off to keep the effect on Home, Lock, or Both, with the original image on the other screen. Atmo stays a live wallpaper, so playlists, the clock and every setting keep working. Keep Atmo selected for both Home and Lock in Android's wallpaper picker.
WAKE TRANSITIONS
An animation as the lock screen arrives from off or from the always-on display: Zoom (up to 150%), Colour fill, Blur, Corner stretch, Shake, Ripple, Glitch, Venetian blind, Breathe, Twirl, Fabric wave, Bubble surge, Scale up, or Random. Each style has its own settings and a length of 50–1000 ms. Random shuffles every style, and the direction of Stretch, Shake, Blinds and Fabric wave, so each plays before any repeats, on each style's defaults or, with Customize each style on, with its own copy of every style's settings.
WALLPAPER CLOCK
A Glass, Translucent, or Adaptive clock drawn into the wallpaper, with drawn fonts, colour, date, depth behind the subject, and drag-and-pinch placement. The date follows the clock's font.
WALLPAPER MODES
• Single Image
• Playlist, from picked images or from folders that stay in sync
• Theme Playlists with separate Light and Dark collections
• Saved playlists to switch back to any time
Playlists shuffle through every image before repeating, never show the same image twice in a row, and keep recent images away from the start of the next round. The order survives setting changes and restarts. A switch delay can stop a quick lock and unlock from changing the image.
FINE TUNING
Animation duration, dimness, glass ribs and transition style, blur, film grain, Atmosphere colour, Halftone dots, Canvas lines, fingerprint position, image fit, wallpaper scrolling, and playlist timing.
Canvas Sketch, Glass, and Halftone share on-device subject isolation: Canvas can anchor its drawing to the subject, and Background only keeps the subject clear for Glass and Halftone.
MATERIAL 3 INTERFACE
Material Expressive styling can follow the system palette or use fixed colors, with System, Light, or Dark appearance and an optional pitch-black background.
VULKAN OR OPENGL ES
Automatic (recommended), Vulkan, or OpenGL ES, applied at once to previews and the wallpaper. Atmo negotiates Vulkan 1.4 down to 1.1. If Vulkan fails, only that effect falls back to OpenGL ES. The main screen shows the API that really rendered the wallpaper.
OFFLINE-FIRST PRIVACY
Images, crops, sketches, palettes, and playlists stay on-device. Atmo requests neither Internet nor network-state permission and contains no advertising or analytics. The F-Droid build bundles an open-source subject model, so it needs no download.
Sync System Colors publishes a locally extracted wallpaper palette through Android's wallpaper API. System-wide theme refresh remains up to the phone manufacturer.
Atmo Engine is released under the MIT License.

fdroid:dev.lutergs.sgaod.description:
SG AOD is a customizable always-on display for Android 12 and newer. It shows the time, date, battery, app notifications and music status on a black background. The app interface is currently in Korean.
Features:
• Adjust clock, date and AM/PM sizes and the overall display scale.
• Choose one of six color presets or enter a custom color.
• Show priority apps separately and choose how many notifications to display.
• Use relative or absolute notification times.
• Follow system automatic brightness or select a manual brightness level.
• Show charging status and the estimated time to full charge when the device provides it.
• Preview your display settings before enabling AOD.
• Automatically darken the display when covered, face down, low on battery, too hot or during configured sleep hours, depending on device support.
Privacy and permissions:
The app has no Internet permission, ads or analytics. Notification and music information stays in memory and is not saved or transmitted. Notification access is optional and enables notification and music display. Display-over-other-apps permission is needed for automatic display. Optional phone permission allows AOD to close during calls. A foreground service keeps the user-enabled feature running.
Before use:
Turn off your device's built-in AOD to avoid overlapping displays. Enable SG AOD and lock the screen. Double-tap the AOD or press a volume key to close it. Background restrictions and sensor support vary by device.
Power and display limitations:
This app keeps an Android activity visible and cannot match or guarantee the power consumption of a manufacturer's system AOD. It requests a 1 Hz display rate, but the OS may ignore that request. App content updates at most once per second, with minute-based clock updates when nothing else changes. Minute-based pixel shifting reduces burn-in risk but cannot eliminate it. Darkening does not always turn off the panel immediately.

fdroid:info.guardianproject.pixelknot.summary: Have a secret that you want to share? Why not hide it in a picture?
fdroid:info.guardianproject.pixelknot.description:
Have a secret that you want to share? Why not hide it in a picture? With PixelKnot, only your friends with the secret password can unlock your special message. Everyone else just sees a pretty picture. It’s a fun and easy way to share hidden messages without anyone knowing. Take those pixels, twist them in a knot, and see for yourself!

★ FOR YOUR EYES ONLY: Put a password on the secret message to make sure that no one can read it except the person it’s meant for.
★ EASY IMAGE CHOOSER: You can use the camera to take photos, or just use photos you’ve already taken.
★ INVISIBLE CHANGES: Even a trained analyst analyst shouldn’t be able to detect any message. The image bytes should seem undistorted.
★ SHARE ACROSS PLATFORMS: Want to share the images over email, file sharing tools (like Dropbox & Sparkleshare), social media (like Google+ & Flickr) or directly through Bluetooth or NFC? Not a problem! The messages are still recoverable on the other side. We'll have even more tools (like Facebook) working soon, so stay tuned!
★ AD-FREE: We want your love, not your money.
★ MATHEMATICALLY SECURE: We use the F5 steganography algorithm which implements matrix encoding to improve the efficiency of embedding and employs permutative straddling to uniformly spread out the changes over the whole steganogram.
★ ATTACK RESISTANT: We’ve launched attacks on images with messages hidden in them using a specialized version of stegdetect, an automated tool for detecting steganographic content in images. In most cases, the pictures have been impervious to attack. We will be including detection in an upcoming version of the application so you can easily test it yourself!

firefox-addons:2820602.name: YouTube AdBlock
firefox-addons:2820602.description:
This is an Add-On Accelerating and Skipping YouTube Ads in Less Than a Second.
- Real-time Acceleration : Ads are sped up on the fly.
- Auto-Skip : Bypass ads as soon as they become skippable.
Works on both desktop and mobile, and in both YouTube Music and Videos.
 Demo video 
How it Works:
A process, running when the current tab is youtube.com/watch , periodically checks the page content for ads. If there is one, the process accelerates it by setting the playback rate to the value set in your config (e.g., 10). As soon as the "Skip Ads ->" button shows up, the process clicks it. When the ad is skipped, the process increments a local private counter of skipped ads in the browser.
Usage:
The add-on should work seamlessly upon installation. 
However, it is possible that the default configuration creates issues (such as triggering the YouTube detection banner) for you, as YouTube provides different different user interfaces / experiences depending on the location, language, etc.
Configurations:
You are welcome to adjust the configurations in the extension's settings (click on the extension's icon in the browser's toolbar).
Description of each parameter:
 Playback Rate: the playback speed desired for the ad. The higher the playback rate, the faster the ad will end, but also the more likely YouTube will notice that an adblock has been used.
 Mute Ad: whether to mute the ad. When the playback rate is low, we can hear the sped-up ad sound; so it can be convenient to mute it.
 Hide Ad: whether to hide the ad by replacing it with a black screen while it is playing.
 Boost After 2s: whether to boost* the ad after 2 seconds.
 If Skip Available: action to perform when the "Skip Ad" button gets available. Options: Click Button: click the button, the natural option.
 Boost Ad: Boost* the ad.
 Do Nothing: Do nothing.
 *Boosting consists in setting the ad timestamp to the end, essentially ending it. This can't be done as soon as the ad starts, as YouTube would detect it.
Avoid YouTube Detection:
If YouTube detected that you used an adblock, you can do the following:
 Adjust the configurations defined above: Reduce the playback rate (e.g., 4),
 Turn OFF Mute Ad, Hide Ad and Boost After 2s,
 Set If Skip Available to Click Button or Do Nothing.
 Reload the page.
 If none of the above worked, write a feedback (see instructions at the end of this document).
Privacy and Security:
- Besides clicking on the "Skip Ads" and increasing the ad playback rate, it does not make any changes to the page.
- It does not collect any data.
- It does not store or retrieve any cookies.
- It stores the number of ads skipped in the local storage, which can only be read by the browser (this information is not accessible to anyone / anything else).
Permissions:
- Access your data for sites in the youtube.com domain: music.youtube.com , www.youtube.com on desktop and m.youtube.com on Android.

Add this extension to configure your browser with a file converter tool & custom web search.
The Converter Suite & Custom Web Search free extension adds an easy-to-use tool to your browser that allows you to convert files to and from PDFs online instantly. Download the extension for free and try it today!

Please share any feedback and ideas on how we can improve our extension. You are free to uninstall the extension at your discretion.
By clicking the button above, you agree to install this extension and abide by the Privacy Policy and Terms of Service of Converter Suite & Custom Web Search.
Yahoo is a registered trademark of Yahoo Inc.

 convertersuite.com is a product offered by Innover Online Media Group Ltd. We provide users with ease of access to information and widgets from their browser. Our Privacy Policy is important for us to continue providing the users with the best possible all-round experience.

 IP address :

We only use this information for analytics and reporting purposes and to provide the functionalities offered by the extension. You can opt out of sharing the above information with us, however, you will only be able to access limited features.

We may also collect information that you may choose to provide us (such as your name, telephone number and/or email address) if submitted by you as part of a feedback form, crash report, enhancement suggestion, or other communication from you to us. apple-macos:6826950120.name: Notes & Reminders: Remindly
apple-macos:6826950120.description:
Remindly is a light, fast notes app for iPhone and iPad. Your notes are stored on the device, so opening one never waits on the network. Read, write, and search with no connection. Changes sync when you're back online.
Capture a thought without losing your place:
• Ask Siri, or add a note from Shortcuts, Spotlight, or the Action button
• Put New Note on the Lock Screen or in Control Center
• Dictate a voice note. It's turned into text on your device, and the audio is kept only if you choose
• Share an article from Safari as a clean note
• Scan or photograph a paper note, and it becomes a note you can edit. Text in scans, photos, and PDFs is recognized on your device, so search can find it
Keep them organized:
• Notebooks, tags, and pins
• Checklists, tables, links, and code blocks
• Type [[ to link to another note
• Reminders, including a date you type in the note
• Photos, PDFs, and other files attached to the note
• Search that opens at the matching line
• Your notes in Spotlight
• App Lock with Face ID or Touch ID
Your notes stay yours:
• Every note is Markdown, so you can take them with you
• No limit on how many notes or notebooks you keep
• Delete your account, and everything in it, from Settings
• The same notes on your Mac and at remindly.com
Sign in with Apple, Google, or your email.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.remindly.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.remindly.com/privacy

apple-itunes:6760923731.description:
Wobbly Generative Art is a curated gallery of mesmerizing generative art animations — flow fields, particle systems, fractals, physics simulations, and more — all running in real-time on your device.
EXPLORE & DISCOVER
Browse a beautiful gallery of wobbles organized by style. Filter by category — particles, geometric, organic, physics, noise — or search by name. Save your favorites for quick access. A rainbow-shifting Liquid Glass interface makes browsing feel as alive as the art itself.
TOUCH & TILT
Every wobble responds to your touch — drag, tap, and swipe to shape the animation in real time. Your phone's gyroscope adds another dimension: tilt your device and watch the art follow your movements. Light touches create subtle shifts; firm presses push the visuals further. It's generative art that feels physical.
CUSTOMIZE & SAVE
Make each wobble your own. Choose from six color themes — Amber, Mono, Blue, Rose, Emerald, and Arctic. Adjust parameters like speed, intensity, and particle count with precision sliders. Your customizations are saved per wobble and remembered between sessions — come back to exactly the setup you love.
LIVE WALLPAPERS
Turn any wobble into a Live Photo wallpaper. Capture 5 seconds of animation and save it directly to your photo library — then set it as your lock screen for a one-of-a-kind animated wallpaper that no one else has.
AMBIENT MODE
Transform your device into a living art display. Ambient mode cycles through your favorite wobbles with smooth cross-fade transitions — each one playing with your saved customizations. A minimal clock keeps time, the screen auto-dims for nighttime use, and the gyroscope makes the art drift with your breathing. Perfect for your nightstand, desk, or as a conversation piece.
FEATURES
• A curated collection of generative art animations
• Touch-interactive — every wobble responds to your gestures
• Gyroscope motion controls — tilt your phone to interact
• Pressure-sensitive touch — light or firm, the art responds
• Six color themes to transform any wobble
• Adjustable parameters: speed, intensity, particle count, and more
• Per-wobble settings that persist between sessions
• Live wallpaper export — save wobbles as animated lock screen wallpapers
• Fullscreen immersive playback with auto-hiding controls
• Ambient mode with cross-fade transitions and clock overlay
• Auto-dim and idle timer for overnight display
• Favorites to save the wobbles you love
• Filter by category or search by name
• Beautiful Liquid Glass interface
• Full accessibility support — VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion
• Photosensitivity warning for strobe effects
• Works completely offline — no internet required
• Light and dark mode support

apple-itunes:1163755850.description:
Collect rare items. Build your own worlds. Find your people.
Build, trade, farm, fish, and explore in Pixel Worlds, an online multiplayer sandbox MMO shaped by its players. Grow your collection, create adventures for others, and play with friends across mobile and PC.
COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Discover thousands of items and create a look of your own. Collect outfits, accessories, pets, weapons, and gear. Mix and match your favorites, hunt for rare finds, and show off your collection wherever you go.
BUILD YOUR OWN WORLDS
Turn your ideas into places other players can explore.
• Build parkour courses, adventure maps, and puzzle rooms
• Create farms, shops, social hubs, and entire communities
• Craft blocks, props, tools, and decorations for your builds
• Design your own games and challenges
• Visit player-created worlds and discover what others have made
TRADE AND GROW YOUR COLLECTION
Buy, sell, and trade with other players in a player-driven economy. Find your next collectible through the Pixel Worlds Exchange, negotiate deals, and trade gear, resources, items, and even worlds.
Farm, craft, and trade to work toward the items you want. Every player-to-player deal is yours to decide, so check what you are receiving before accepting.
EXPLORE AND ADVENTURE
Enter dangerous dungeons, explore underground areas, and battle enemies for valuable loot. Mine resources, progress your character, and unlock stronger equipment as you take on new challenges.
Adventure alone or with friends, and discover rewards to use, collect, or trade.
FARM, CROSSBREED, AND CRAFT
Create a farm and grow more than crops. Combine and crossbreed seeds to produce building blocks, furniture, tools, weapons, clothes, and more.
Earn gems, gather materials, and craft new items for your character, your worlds, or your next trade.
GO FISHING
Grab your rod and chase your next big catch.
• Catch fish of different sizes and values
• Sell your catches for gems
• Craft better fishing equipment
• Compete in fishing tournaments for valuable prizes
MEET FRIENDS AND PLAY TOGETHER
Chat with players from around the world, visit their creations, and find your favorite places to hang out. Collaborate on ambitious builds, join community-made activities, or explore together in real time.
Take part in seasonal events and discover limited-time content alongside the community.
PLAY ACROSS PLATFORMS
Continue your adventure on mobile or PC and play with friends across supported platforms.
PIXEL WORLDS IS BACK
Created by many of the original developers, Pixel Worlds returns with a fresh start for everyone. Previous accounts, worlds, items, and progression do not carry over, and the in-game economy has been reset.
Start your collection. Build your world. Make new memories together.
An internet connection is required to play.
